clauses.title: Scope – Requirements for
clauses.text: 1. Scope - Requirements for  washers for corrugated sheet roofing.

clauses.title: Types
clauses.text: 2. Types a)   Bituminous felt washers, b)   Steel washers, and c)   Lead washers.

clauses.title: Bituminous felt washers and
clauses.text: 2.1 Bituminous felt washers and lead washers are of two types namely Type A and Type B, and steel washers are  four types namely Type A, Type B, Type C and Type D.

clauses.title: Dimensions (in mm)
clauses.text: 3. Dimensions (in mm) Nominal Size Thickness Suitable (Dia of Hole) Bolt Size 7 1.6 M6 10 1.6 M8 12 1.6 M10 For detailed information, refer to  IS 8869 : 1978 Specification for washers for corrugated sheet roofing. Note 1—The dimensions given in the above table shall  be applicable to all types of washersmentioned in 2 and  2.1. Note 2— For detailed dimensions and shapes of washers of all types, refer to Tables 1 to 3 of the standard.

clauses.title: Grade – Ordinary grade
clauses.text: 4. Grade - Ordinary grade specified in IS 5369.

clauses.title: Designation – As an
clauses.text: 5. Designation - As an example, a bituminous felt washer, Type A of nominal size 7 shall be designated as `Bituminous Felt Washer A7 - IS 8869.

clauses.title: Steel washers shall be
clauses.text: 6.1 Steel washers shall be galvanized by hot dipping.

clauses.title: Bituminous felt washers shall be suitably
clauses.text: 6.2 Bituminous felt washers shall be suitably impregnated. These washers when heated and maintained at a temperature of 75 ± 10C for 1 hour shall not get separated and flow out. * General requirements for plain washers and lock washers (first revision). SUMMARY OF IS 8869 : 1978 WASHERS FOR CORRUGATED SHEET ROOFING
